blend.note: a NEW emergent culture, neither Roman nor Chinese - the silk-land: a vast law-and-Mandate empire of legions and a celestial bureaucracy, its tongue, titles and gods fused forms (Latin -us/-a + Chinese monosyllables).

_note: Cross-family DEEP BLEND (Roman + Chinese): a single emergent civilization - the silk-land Serica, a great law-giving empire that weds the Roman legion, road and codex to the Chinese walled-city, bureaucracy and Mandate of Heaven. Not backbone+overlay: the lexicon, titles and deity-names are genuinely fused (Latin -us/-a + Chinese monosyllabic roots). civ = feudal. Seeds/shifts Lawful or Neutral. Common-word lexicon and rank titles fuse the real Latin/Chinese registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real gods.

phonology.palette: Fused Latin-Sinitic: Latin syllables (st, pr, -us/-a/-or) meet Chinese monosyllables (-cheng, -shan, zh/ch/x/q, finals -n/-ng); fused endings -us on Chinese roots, or monosyllable + Latin office-ending.
phonology.phonotactics: CV(C); Latin clusters + Chinese tight monosyllables (no Chinese clusters); fused -us/-eng/-an.

morphology.patronymic_form: the gens-xing (a fused clan-surname, family-first) + a given praenomen-ming; a courtesy-name for officials; generation-names within the lineage.
morphology.compounding_rule: [surname-xing] + [given]; toponyms quality + type: Aur-cheng (golden-city), Via-Serica (the silk-road), Mon-shan (the mountain).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a law-and-Mandate empire: the Imperdi holds the Mandate over the peerage and a vast literate magistracy; the legions and the codex sustain the order)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Fused Latin-Sinitic, ascending; titles blend the two (Latin castellanus/comes/dux/princeps/rex/imperator + Chinese nan/dudu/bo/hou/gong/wang/huangdi). Castelnan (castellan-baron) barony; Limitudu (march-commander) march; Combo (count) county; Duxou (duke-marquis) duchy; Princong (prince-duke) principality; Rexwang (king) kingdom; Imperdi (emperor, holding the Mandate) over the Imperdium. The legions (legio) and the celestial magistracy serve the throne. (Rank titles fuse the real Latin/Chinese register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: the gens-xing surname first, then a given praenomen-ming; a courtesy-name (zi) for adults; the magistracy and legions add an office-title.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the magistracy and learned take a courtesy-name and sobriquet; commoners surname + given.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke virtue and the celestial powers' epithets; e.g. Tian-en (heaven's grace), a temple-name honoring Tulin-di.

religion._note: Deity-names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon (Latin + Sinitic), never real Roman/Chinese gods. Serican seeds/shifts Lawful or Neutral; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). A Celestial Bureaucracy under the Mandate of Heaven, fused with the Roman law-cult: the One (Aiterneng) is Highest Heaven and source of the Mandate; the Lawful powers the celestial magistracy that gave the law; the templ-miao temple and the law-curia keep the rite.
religion.the_one: Aiterneng (< Aeternus; fused Latin Aeternus / Sinitic Aiteng) - Highest Heaven, the source of the Mandate and the law; revered above all when Lawful, served-not-petitioned when Neutral

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tulin (sun and judgment, lord of the law-stele; Lawful power)
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numengus (the scribe-wisdom, keeper of the codex; Lawful power)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aiterneng) and the Lawful powers (Tulin, Orlanus, Numengus, Gaidunus), demonize the Chaotic demon-marshals (Maraluo, Wucidus, Lusanus)
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent; foreground the deified ancestors (the ancestral hall and the Divi) and the local earth-and-grain powers

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers are the demon-marshals outside the celestial order, each with an epithet: Maraxus -> Maraluo the War-Fire Marshal; Vacidus -> Wucidus the Devourer; Lusanto -> Lusanus the Coin-Serpent.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Templ-miao (temple) of [power]: 'the Templ-miao of Tulin'; the law-curia keeps its codex-stele.
religion.saints_pattern: deified law-givers and worthy officials enrolled in the celestial register; 'Divus [name]' / 'the Lord [name]', honored at the ancestral hall and the miao.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tulin: a winged sun-disc above the law-stele and the scales
holy_symbol_motifs.Numengus: stylus and codex above the seal of office

banks_patterns.ships: grand-canal junks and war-galleys: 'the Aquila', 'the Jade Dragon', 'the Mandate of Heaven'
banks_patterns.military_units: the Legio of [number/god] / the [color] Banner: 'the Legio of Orlanus', 'the Azure Banner'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried law-cities and tomb-mounds along the silk-road: 'the Tomb of [name]', 'the Ruined Cheng of [warlord]'
